title: EODC Federation Extension
description: Federated-provider attribution and metadata-harmonization provenance for the EODC STAC catalogue. The federation is search-time only: collections are not merged, so each harmonized collection maps to exactly one source.

federation:backends.title: Federated providers
federation:backends.description: Providers that can serve this object.

provenance.title: Federation provenance
provenance.description: The harmonization profile applied and what it changed. Minimal by design: the collection's own id, its providers (summaries['federation:backends']) and its stac_version are already on the object, and the origin of a pass-through is a standard 'via' link, so none of them are repeated here. Emitted only when the harmonization changed something.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Harmonization profile and rule version in one token, 'name@version' (e.g. 'eodc-stac-v1@1').

changes.title: Changes
changes.description: Plain-language summary of what the harmonization changed.
